Bill.BriefDescription: Designating July 25th as patient safety day.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to designating July 25th as patient safety day; andadding a new section to chapter 1.20 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 1.20 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) The legislature finds that: (a) Everyone is entitled to safe and effective health care; (b) Our health care delivery system has a paramount duty to makepatient safety a top priority; (c) Despite the best efforts of health care providers andfacilities, preventable medical errors, prescription drug misuse, andother unintended consequences that negatively affect patients canoccur; (d) Health care providers and facilities in Washington arecommitted to promoting patient safety and eliminating medical errors; (e) Common measures for reporting health care performance, alongwith patient education and engagement, are critical to Washingtoncitizens making informed health choices; and p. 1 HB 2225 (f) Washington state strives to promote the importance of patientsafety in the delivery of quality health care. (2) It is therefore the legislature's intent to designate July 25thof each year as patient safety day in memory of patients who havesuffered from preventable medical errors, to honor all people whostrive to improve medical safety, and to raise the awareness of theparamount importance of patient safety.
